text: "Carpentry entails a series of procedures that necessitate meticulousness and accuracy. An essential action is sanding, which aims to smooth the surface of a board to a degree of comfort. Subsequently, sawing follows, where a sharp blade is utilized to cut through the wood. This process can involve multiple passes and precise cuts. After the sawing is finished, sanding is the next step, during which the sawdust and wood chips are eliminated to achieve the desired surface texture. This process is vital, as a well-sawn and sanded board will appear and feel excellent when complete."
